text: DSH Knowledge Work（DSH 插件，Web、桌面与 CLI）：为 DSH 增加销售、财务、法务、数据、设计、工程等知识工作角色技能。插件将各角色作为可独立启停的条目接入 skills 服务，扫描对应技能目录并按需向模型提供技能说明和正文。用户可按工作场景选择角色，减少无关技能同时加载；适合希望在 DSH 中调用专业工作流程的用户。部分合作方技能需要对应连接器。

DSH Knowledge Work adds sales, finance, legal, data, design, and engineering skills for DSH. It registers roles as separate entries in the skills service, discovers skill folders, and provides descriptions and content to the model on demand. Partner workflows need their corresponding connectors.
想让 DSH 按销售、财务或工程工作场景加载对应的专业技能。
我想在 DSH 里启用一组可单独开关的知识工作角色技能。
I want DSH to load role-specific work skills on demand through its skill catalog.
DSH Knowledge Work 的功能「按角色提供技能」：它为所选角色发现技能目录，将技能名称和说明注册到 DSH skills 服务，并在模型请求具体技能时读取正文。角色由独立入口注册。
DSH Knowledge Work 的功能「独立切换工作角色」：bundle 为销售、财务、法务、数据等角色分别建立 Loader 条目，用户可在 DSH 插件页单独启用或关闭某个角色。
DSH Knowledge Work 的 Apollo、Common Room、Slack 和 Zoom 合作方角色需要对应连接器；没有连接器时，技能仍可加载和说明流程，但不能读写合作方数据。
dsh-knowledge-work 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 19 天；提交数 4；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

dsh-knowledge-work README · dsh-knowledge-work：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that adds
225 knowledge-work skills across 22 independently switchable role rows — sales,
small business, finance, legal, data, engineering, design, marketing, operations,
product, customer support, HR, bio-research, productivity, PDF reading, enterprise
search, plugin authoring, plus Apollo, brand-voice, Common Room, Slack, and Zoom.

dsh-knowledge-work README · dsh-knowledge-work：The skills come from Anthropic's open-source
[anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins](https://github.com/anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins)
(Apache-2.0); see [ATTRIBUTION.md](ATTRIBUTION.md) for what was ported and how.

dsh-knowledge-work README · Requirements：- DeepSeek Harness `>= 0.2.1-rc.2 < 0.3.0` (declared as `engines.dsh`).
- A preset that exposes skill discovery and loading (the default presets do).

dsh-knowledge-work README · Plugins page (Desktop / Web)：Open **Plugins**, choose to install a package from GitHub, and enter:

```text
github:AlbertZJ/dsh-knowledge-work
```

The bundle is enabled right after installation. Its details page lists the 22 role
rows, each with its own switch.

dsh-knowledge-work README · CLI：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:AlbertZJ/dsh-knowledge-work
dsh --profile web --dump-config   # the layer appears as "# == dsh-knowledge-work"
```

No install-time build permission is needed: `lib/` is committed to this repository
and the package declares no `prepare` script, so pnpm has nothing to allowlist.

Pin a commit for reproducible installs:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:AlbertZJ/dsh-knowledge-work#<commit-sha>
```

dsh-knowledge-work README · From npm (after publishing)：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-knowledge-work
```

dsh-knowledge-work README · From a local checkout (development)：```sh
dsh plugin --profile dev add /absolute/path/to/dsh-knowledge-work
```

dsh-knowledge-work README · Use the skills：Enable the **Knowledge-work skills** bundle in **Plugins**, then turn roles on or
off in the bundle's details page. Each role is a separate plugin row: switching
one off unloads its provider and removes its skills from the catalog without
touching the other rows. The switches persist in the profile patch layer.

dsh-knowledge-work README · Use the skills：A skill whose folder name appears in more than one role gets a `<role>-<skill>`
prefix so names stay stable when neighbouring rows are switched off — for
example `sales-account-research` and `sales-call-prep` (the same skill names also
exist in Common Room).

Skills are loaded on demand by the model through the skill tool; their bodies are
not part of every request until selected.

dsh-knowledge-work README · Roles：Partner-built rows need their vendor's connector (Apollo, Common Room, Slack,
Zoom). Without it the skill still loads and explains the workflow, but it cannot
read or write partner data. Brand-voice works from uploaded material.

dsh-knowledge-work README · How it works：```text
dsh-knowledge-work/
├── cordis.patch.yml     # bundle layer: one group row + 22 role rows
├── lib/                 # built entries (index.js + one <role>.js per role)
├── assets/<role>/<skill>/SKILL.md

dsh-knowledge-work README · How it works：`cordis.patch.yml` inserts each role as its own Loader row named
`dsh-knowledge-work/<role>`. Each entry registers a skill provider with the
`skills` service and discovers `<role>/<skill>/SKILL.md` under `assets/` at
runtime. The package `exports` map serves the role subpaths and their locale
files, which is how the Plugins page reads row titles without running the code.

dsh-knowledge-work README · How it works：Not ported: upstream `.mcp.json` connectors, slash commands, sub-agents, and
plugin settings. See [ATTRIBUTION.md](ATTRIBUTION.md).

dsh-knowledge-work README · Development：```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run build    # tsc -> lib/types, tsdown -> lib/*.js, then remove lib/types
pnpm run verify   # counts, locale pairing, patch rows, and exports
```

`lib/` is committed: git installs fetch sources and do not build them, so rebuild
and commit `lib/` together with any `src/` change.
